Claim 13 (Cancelled): 

Claim 23 (Currently amended): A computer-based system for trading combinations of financial instruments, said system comprising: a computer-readable storage medium including computer-executable instructions for obtaining combination orders to trade financial instruments; and a processor configured to obtain a matched collection of expanded eligible orders, wherein an obtained order is eligible if it satisfies at least one selected condition, and wherein said at least one selected condition includes the necessary condition that all financial instruments specified by the legs of an eligible order are in a set of two or more selected financial instruments.

Claim 24 (Currently amended): The system of claim 23, further comprising a processor configured to increase, at least in principle, the quality of said matched collection.

Claim 25 (Currently amended): The system of claim 23, further comprising a processor configured to provide additional trading functionality.
